description: This Python source file provides utility functions for processing documentation files, including chunking markdown and text files, handling headings, sanitizing text for database storage, and reading files with encoding fallback.

classes.name: HeadingIndex
classes.description: Data class representing the position and title of a heading within a text document.

methods.name: is_supported_file
methods.description: Checks if a file path has a supported extension for ingestion.

methods.name: _sanitize_text
methods.description: Removes null bytes from text to ensure compatibility with PostgreSQL storage.

methods.name: read_text
methods.description: Reads text from a file with UTF-8 encoding, falling back to Latin-1 if necessary, and sanitizes it.

methods.name: _collect_headings
methods.description: Extracts headings from markdown text, returning their positions and titles.

methods.name: _newline_positions
methods.description: Returns a list of newline character positions in the text.

methods.name: _char_to_line
methods.description: Converts a character index to a line number based on newline positions.

methods.name: _find_section
methods.description: Finds the section heading corresponding to a character index.

methods.name: chunk_markdown_text
methods.description: Splits markdown text into chunks with metadata, tracking headings and line numbers.

methods.name: summarize_files
methods.description: Creates a human-readable summary of a list of file paths.
